profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at 2K
profile.summary:
I’m a passionate software and game engineer with over 8 years of professional experience, focused on building scalable, performant systems that support complex gameplay and real user interactions. I enjoy working on practical solutions that balance optimization, reliability, and a strong player experience.

My experience spans Unreal Engine and C++ gameplay development, large-scale automation and CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native infrastructure. I’ve worked extensively with Perforce-based workflows, GitHub workflows, automated build and test systems, and containerized deployments running in orchestrated environments across AWS and GCP with experience in Azure. Experienced debugging Linux-based systems and services, working across multiple development environments, and operating distributed systems with observability and monitoring in mind.

I’m a fast learner, a collaborative team player, and someone who enjoys digging into complex technical problems alongside designers, engineers, and QA. I specialize in C++, Unreal Engine, C#, and Unity, with additional experience in Java, Python, PowerShell, Groovy, and Selenium. I’m always eager to keep learning and growing as an engineer in and outside of the workplace.

Let’s connect!

positions.title: Senior Gameplay/Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Multi-disciplined engineer that leveled up internally during my tenure, operated as a generalist gameplay engineer that migrated into a strong automation focus on a large-scale live service MMO pioneering automation efforts such as CI/CD pipelines, test framework development, documentation and runbooks, and internal tooling.

Shipped into Early Access on Steam

Contributed to gameplay systems including chat, audio, combat, and core gameplay features. Built and maintained internal automation and testing tools to support functional validation, large-scale client simulation, and continuous integration workflows. Collaborated with engineering teams on internal services supporting test orchestration, and contributed to onboarding, interviewing/hiring process, internal tooling efforts, and more
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Gameplay Programming · Automation Framework · Automated Processes · MMORPG

positions.title: Game Developer
positions.description:
Developed and shipped engaging electronic pull-tab and board-style gaming experiences using Unity and C#, implementing payout logic driven by game design and mathematical specifications for regulated markets nationwide. Collaborated within a multi-disciplinary engineering team using GitHub and Azure DevOps, participating in code reviews and supporting build, release, and deployment workflows across multiple projects.

Extended and maintained internal development libraries leveraged across teams, supporting shared systems such as backend integration, payout solving, and data persistence. Diagnosed and resolved payout discrepancies, stability issues, and quality-of-life bugs, including visual and audio defects, to improve overall product reliability and player experience.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Designed and implemented improved hiring and onboarding processes, along with internal tooling, to raise testing quality and operational efficiency within the department. Owned and maintained the automation framework, performing code reviews, validating changes, and developing new features to support evolving testing needs.

Led a team of Automation Engineers focused on building solutions that improved quality-of-life and effectiveness across Quality Assurance. Coordinated and prioritized workloads for analysts and engineers throughout the studio’s game development cycle. Served as the acting Quality Assurance engineering lead during team growth phases, contributing hands-on engineering work while scaling and onboarding new team members.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented an automated unit and functional testing framework to validate payout logic derived from game design and mathematical specifications for state-regulated gaming markets. Managed and prioritized workloads for analysts, coordinating game development and testing efforts across the studio.

Ensured games met quality and regulatory standards for release, contributing to the successful shipment of multiple of titles with no outstanding critical issues. Maintained and monitored Azure DevOps build and release pipelines to validate changes throughout the game lifecycle.

Used SQL to verify database integrity, confirming correct data updates and stored procedure execution during gameplay and payout flows. Authored automated test cases to expand coverage and improve overall test reliability and consistency.

positions.title: Game Developer (Co-Founder)
positions.description:
Co-founded and engineered a multiplayer social platform, contributing across core systems including online chat and emote functionality, auto-update and custom installation pipelines, a bespoke launcher, CDN-backed asset delivery, in-game gameplay systems, and a developer-facing IDE supporting an embedded Lua scripting environment.

Designed and maintained backend data storage using SQL to manage user accounts, build deployments, and platform data, integrating secure API access and authentication mechanisms. Collaborated closely with a small, cross-functional team aligned on a shared vision to create an accessible platform for aspiring game developers to learn and build interactive experiences.

Used GitHub for source control, code reviews, and build management to coordinate development and maintain code quality across the team.
positions.insights: Skills: Unity · C# · Multiplayer Games · Launcher · Gameplay Programming

positions.title: Unity Game Developer Intern
positions.description:
Developer on Food Fight VR (v1.1), leading a major overhaul driven by user feedback from the initial release. Owned end-to-end development efforts including system design, cross-platform Oculus porting, repository management, and feature implementation.

Delivered substantial updates such as an interactive tutorial, new level designs, improved onboarding and gamification, and refinements based on an expanding player base. Collaborated with a cross-functional team of approximately 10 developers, artists, and QA testers to meet product and client expectations.
Managed source control and team workflows using GitHub to coordinate development and maintain project stability.

Link Meta Store: https://www.meta.com/experiences/pcvr/foodfight/2792691784081696/
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Unity · Gameplay Programming · Virtual Reality (VR) · Project Management

positions.title: QA Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented an automated web testing framework using Java and Selenium, executing scheduled test suites against a proprietary web-based case management system and generating structured reports via a reporting library.

Implemented cross-browser testing to simulate real user interactions, validating system behavior against product requirements and flagging unintended responses with detailed failure diagnostics. Test results were automatically compiled and distributed via email to developers and department leadership for review and follow-up.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Selenium · Automation Framework · QA Automation · Communication
